main.label: INCLUSIVE COMMUNITY SUPPORT
main.title: Disability Inclusion & Mental Health
main.text: Removing barriers, promoting dignity and independence, and ensuring equal opportunities for persons with disabilities to participate fully in community life.
main.heading: CAWAP Disability Inclusion Program
main.text2: The Canadian and African Women Aid Program (CAWAP) supports persons with disabilities through advocacy, accessibility awareness, skills development, employment readiness, community referrals, and inclusive programming.
main.text3: Our goal is to remove barriers, promote dignity and independence, and ensure that persons with disabilities have equal opportunities to participate fully in community life.
main.text4: CAWAP is committed to building a society where every person is respected, empowered, included, and given the opportunity to thrive.

servicesGrid.text: Championing the rights of persons with disabilities and raising awareness about accessibility and inclusion within the community.
servicesGrid.text2: Providing training and capacity-building opportunities tailored to individual abilities and career aspirations.
servicesGrid.text3: Equipping individuals with job search skills, resume building, interview preparation, and workplace accommodation guidance.
servicesGrid.text4: Connecting individuals with specialized services, resources, and support networks within the broader community.
servicesGrid.text5: Building a society where every person is respected, empowered, included, and given the opportunity to thrive.
servicesGrid.heading: Also: Mental Health Support
servicesGrid.text6: Breaking the stigma and promoting mental wellness in our community
servicesGrid.text7: We believe that mental health is a fundamental aspect of overall well-being, and we are dedicated to eradicating the stigma surrounding mental illnesses.
servicesGrid.text8: Our Mental Health program provides support, education, and resources to individuals and families affected by mental health challenges. We create a safe, non-judgmental space where people can seek help, share their experiences, and access professional support.
servicesGrid.text9: Through awareness campaigns, support groups, counseling services, and educational workshops, we work to promote mental wellness and ensure that everyone has access to the mental health care they need.
servicesGrid.label: Mental health awareness and education
servicesGrid.label3: Referrals to professional mental health services
